people.name: Brian Houghton Hodgson
people.note: English Resident at Kathmandu at the court of Nepal, manuscript collector and scholar of Buddhism.

people.name: Daniel Wright
people.note: English physician in Nepal and manuscript collector; brother of William Wright.

people.name: Alexander Csoma de Kőrös
people.note: Explorer and Tibetologist who died in Darjeeling.
